stories.title: Billy Gunn refused to ask Tony Khan to hire his sons
stories.tldr: Billy Gunn revealed that he strictly refused to ask Tony Khan to hire his sons, Austin and Colten, into AEW before they had finished college and earned their own opportunities. Despite being a veteran of the business and a member of DX, Gunn wanted his children to experience the traditional struggles of the industry and prove themselves rather than receiving hand-outs. He initially hoped they would pursue different career paths due to the grueling travel schedule he experienced, but ultimately supported them after they met his educational demands. Both sons eventually secured their spots in AEW through official tryouts and have since gone on to capture tag team and trios gold.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov opens up about suffering panic attacks during matches
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov recently revealed in an interview with Ariel Helwani that he consistently experiences panic attacks during his wrestling matches, sometimes occurring multiple times every week. Rather than fighting these episodes, Dragunov has learned to accept them as part of who he is, noting that the intense feelings actually fuel his passion, dedication, and in-ring performances. Despite suffering attacks during his entrances and even fearing he might forget his matches, his hard work and resilience allow him to successfully do his job. Now done with WWE, Dragunov recently made his AEW debut at WrestleDream 2026.

stories.title: Mick Foley explains becoming an early supporter of Willow Nightingale
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently explained how he became an early supporter of AEW star Willow Nightingale due to her kindness toward his daughter Noelle during her wrestling training. Nightingale, who has frequently cited Foley as her all-time favorite wrestler, earned the Hardcore Legend's deep respect and admiration long before achieving championship success in AEW. The mutual bond between the two has continued to flourish as co-workers, highlighted recently when Foley sent a congratulatory text after Nightingale's classic match against Mercedes Mone at All In.

stories.title: Will Ospreay & Adam Copeland team up on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland will form a surprising tag team on AEW Dynamite to face Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight following their recent clashes. The stacked card in Coral Gables also features Ilja Dragunov making his highly anticipated AEW in-ring debut against Speedball Mike Bailey. Additionally, Queen Aminata will battle the returning Maya World in a number one contender match for Persephone's TBS Championship, and The Young Bucks will take on Mark Davis and Jake Doyle.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov expresses desire to wrestle in Japan
stories.tldr: Newly signed AEW wrestler Ilja Dragunov recently expressed a strong desire to perform in Japan during an interview with TMZ. He explained that his intense in-ring style would deeply resonate with Japanese wrestling fans and culture. Dragunov noted that while he wrestled on wXw cards associated with Big Japan Pro Wrestling early in his career, those events took place in Germany. Following his recent AEW debut at WrestleDream 2026 in Orlando, a trip to Japan remains a major career goal for the star.

stories.title: Billy Gunn pulled from Create-A-Pro event due to AEW commitments
stories.tldr: Billy Gunn has been pulled from an upcoming Create-A-Pro Wrestling event this Saturday due to AEW contractual obligations, as AEW has a Collision show scheduled for the same night in North Carolina. To make up for the absence, promotion owners Brian Myers and Pat Buck secured AEW star and school alumnus MJF alongside broadcaster Alicia Atout for meet and greets. Refunds are being issued for all Gunn and New Age Outlaws photo packages, though Road Dogg will still appear at the Merrick Bellmore Little League fundraiser.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov unconcerned about standing out on AEW's roster
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov recently addressed concerns about getting lost in the shuffle on aew's heavily stacked roster. Speaking in a recent interview, Dragunov revealed that he has zero fear about standing out because he has always bet on himself throughout his fourteen year career. He pointed to his major debut presentation at wrestledream as proof that the company already recognizes what makes him uniquely different from everyone else. Dragunov believes that wrestlers only get overlooked when they try to blend in and act like the rest of the locker room.

stories.title: Lee Moriarty and LA Cherry announce engagement
stories.tldr: ROH Pure Champion Lee Moriarty and wrestling personality LA Cherry have announced their official engagement after Moriarty proposed at the Sunken Gardens in St. Petersburg, Florida. Cherry shared the happy news on Instagram on Monday, October 19, alongside a photo and the caption Forever. Cherry is well-known to fans for regularly attending All Elite Wrestling and Ring of Honor events alongside Moriarty, who is currently dominating the company with a historic Pure Championship reign surpassing 800 days. As he celebrates this major personal milestone, Moriarty is also preparing for his upcoming title defense and appearances, being advertised for the upcoming ROH Final Battle event scheduled for Friday, December 4, in San Antonio, Texas.

stories.title: Rush and Dralistico AEW contract status updates following cryptic posts
stories.tldr: Dralistico's AEW contract is reportedly set to expire this December, fueling speculation that he wants to leave the promotion following his cryptic social media post. Meanwhile, his brother Rush has clarified that his own mysterious absence and posts are entirely due to an expired work visa rather than unhappiness with the company. Rush confirmed he remains happy with AEW but is not expected to return until his visa situation is resolved around the start of the new year.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov to face Mike Bailey in AEW Dynamite debut
stories.tldr: Speedball Mike Bailey has been revealed as the opponent for Ilja Dragunov's upcoming in-ring debut. Tony Khan announced the marquee matchup for the October 21 episode of AEW Dynamite in Coral Gables, Florida. Several other high-profile bouts were also added to the card for the live broadcast.

stories.title: Medical examiner details released surrounding PAC's death
stories.tldr: Newly released medical examiner records reveal heartbreaking details from the final hours of Benjamin PAC Satterley, including a phone call from his wife to his cell phone while police were already investigating his unresponsive state in a rental car. Investigators confirmed he had spoken to his wife less than three hours before his death, telling her he was stopping for food before heading to O'Hare Airport. Although inhalers were recovered at the scene, the report could not determine if he had time to use them during the fatal bronchial asthma attack. Meanwhile, fellow wrestlers continue to share emotional memories, with Nick Jackson recently recalling a vivid dream about the late star.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov responds to MJF mocking his AEW debut
stories.tldr: Following MJF mocking his AEW WrestleDream debut, Ilja Dragunov has officially responded to the criticism. Appearing on the Battleground Podcast, Dragunov offered a completely dismissive reaction when asked what he would say back to MJF. He explained that he views MJF as a problem lacking relevance and prefers to focus on physical punishment like chops and elbows rather than trading insults online.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa expresses desire for NJPW match
stories.tldr: AEW star Tommaso Ciampa has expressed interest in wrestling for NJPW and specifically hopes to face former IWGP Heavyweight Champion Shingo Takagi for a few select matches. Takagi has been heavily involved in cross promotional feuds with AEW talent like Claudio Castagnoli and Jon Moxley. Meanwhile, Ciampa is coming off a National Championship match against Andrade El Idolo at AEW WrestleDream.

stories.title: Billy Gunn calls Triple H's Hall of Fame 'pissant company' joke a dick move
stories.tldr: During a recent interview, WWE Hall of Famer Billy Gunn reflected on Triple H's infamous 2019 D-Generation X Hall of Fame speech where he disparaged AEW as a pissant company. Gunn revealed that he anticipated the jab and secured permission from AEW President Tony Khan to attend the ceremony beforehand. Although he expected WWE to address his association with the rival promotion, Gunn ultimately described Triple H's comments as an unnecessary and poor attempt to save face.

stories.title: Billy Gunn reflects on the 2022 AEW All Out backstage fight
stories.tldr: AEW coach and WWE Hall of Famer Billy Gunn recently shared his perspective on the infamous 2022 AEW All Out backstage brawl between CM Punk and The Elite. Although he was not directly involved and avoids media coverage of the event, Gunn suggested that younger talent provoked a veteran who simply would not tolerate it. He contrasted modern locker room issues with how Vince McMahon managed WWE talent, emphasizing that wrestlers do not need to like each other to conduct business professionally. Gunn concluded that personal grievances should be handled privately behind closed doors like grown adults rather than airing them out publicly.

stories.title: Nick Jackson praises Tony Khan and feels he deserves more credit
stories.tldr: Following AEW WrestleDream, The Young Bucks expressed deep gratitude toward AEW President Tony Khan for their long careers and ongoing platform. Nick Jackson admitted that Khan does not get enough praise or credit from them, emphasizing his immense loyalty and appreciation. The veteran duo also reflected on their grueling match and offered high praise for their younger opponents, Kevin Knight and Kyle Fletcher.

stories.title: Will Ospreay prefers to focus on AEW rather than discuss WWE
stories.tldr: AEW World Champion Will Ospreay recently addressed why he prefers to keep his attention on All Elite Wrestling rather than continually answering interview questions about WWE. While acknowledging that inquiries about rival promotions are simply part of the job, Ospreay made it clear that he cares little for other companies and is fully invested in AEW's mission to change professional wrestling. During the same interview, he also praised former WWE stars Creed and Kofi for fitting right into the AEW locker room and bringing a willingness to help the growing promotion.

stories.title: Thekla sparks no-selling debate following AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Thekla has ignited a passionate debate among wrestling fans following her AEW Women's World Championship match against Mercedes Moné at WrestleDream 2026. After losing the match to Moné, fan footage showed Thekla rolling out of the ring, flipping off the crowd, and dancing up the aisle. Critics argued she recovered too quickly and failed to properly sell the finisher, while defenders claimed her reaction fit her heel persona and noted she spent time down on the mat first. Moné later addressed the incident during the post-show media scrum, dismissively comparing her challenger to a vocal chihuahua.

stories.title: Dralistico hints at potential AEW departure
stories.tldr: AEW wrestler Dralistico has sparked speculation about his future with the promotion by posting an AI-generated image of himself behind bars on social media, echoing a similar tactic previously used by Rey Fenix. This cryptic post arrives amidst growing uncertainty regarding the contract statuses of Dralistico and his brother Rush, neither of whom have appeared on AEW television in months. Meanwhile, their brother Dragon Lee faces a similar contract expiration timeline with WWE, adding further intrigue to the family's wrestling future.

stories.title: WWE's internal reaction to Ilja Dragunov signing with AEW
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov joining AEW has generated no hard feelings or backstage animosity within WWE. While Triple H ultimately wanted to keep him, friends and management are happy for his new opportunity and understand talent chasing better financial deals. Dragunov officially debuted at WrestleDream following the expiration of his WWE contract and subsequent visa delays. He explained that he joined AEW to find a fresh environment and new competition at this stage of his career.

stories.title: Mike Bailey explains origins of rumor regarding MVP feud
stories.tldr: Mike Bailey recently discussed the origins of a bizarre, false rumor from nearly a year ago claiming he and MVP were feuding backstage. MVP previously shut down the rumors by publicly calling Bailey one of the nicest guys in the industry. Bailey explained that the rumor started from an absurd online story that gained traction among fans who enjoy backstage drama. Instead of ignoring it, the two wrestlers leaned into the situation by releasing a humorous viral video, which ultimately turned their dynamic into an ongoing inside joke where they playfully greet each other with profanity.

stories.title: Keith Lee's current AEW status updated
stories.tldr: Keith Lee remains absent from All Elite Wrestling television as he continues to navigate his recovery following health issues and surgeries. Although internal discussions regarding a potential return took place earlier, backstage reports indicate that the company currently has no creative plans for the former champion. Industry speculation regarding his potential retirement has circulated, but Lee has not made any public announcements about his in-ring future.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show review of AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: The latest review of AEW WrestleDream breaks down a loaded event highlighted by an inaugural Clockwork Carnage match where Will Ospreay defended the AEW World Championship against seven other competitors. The card also featured a deeply emotional Continental Championship defense by Jon Moxley against Mark Davis, high-stakes bouts involving Andrade El Idolo and Tomasso Ciampa, and the start of a best-of-five series between FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns. Furthermore, the show delivered a major surprise debut with former WWE star Ilja Dragunov officially arriving in the company.

stories.title: Update on Kairi Sane's AEW negotiations and visa status
stories.tldr: Clarifying recent speculation, Kairi Sane is not being kept out of AEW by visa issues because she remains completely unsigned. Her previous work visa has expired, but sponsorship and an expedited renewal can be secured in as little as fifteen business days once a contract is finalized. Alongside ongoing talks in the United States, she also has multiple standing offers to wrestle in Japan. Fans will next see her on Chris Jericho's November cruise, an event taking place in international waters that bypasses visa requirements entirely.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov explains decision to leave WWE for AEW
stories.tldr: Following his surprise debut at AEW WrestleDream, Ilja Dragunov has explained his decision to leave WWE after failing to reach a new contractual agreement in August. Speaking at the post-show press scrum, Dragunov revealed he felt creatively restricted and needed a fresh landscape to satisfy his hunger for competition. The newly signed star is set to make his official in-ring debut this Wednesday on AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné provides update on broken nose suffered at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone continues to wrestle despite her nose still being severely broken a month and a half after surgery. She originally suffered the injury against Willow Nightingale at All In and recently defended her title against Thekla at WrestleDream. During the post-show media scrum, Mone emphasized that the lingering pain will not stop her from maintaining her championship reign.

stories.title: Will Ospreay addresses MJF carrying title belt while absent
stories.tldr: Following his recent criticisms of AEW, absent star MJF has continued parading around with his own championship belt and declaring himself the true titleholder. During the post WrestleDream media scrum, AEW World Champion Will Ospreay humorously addressed the situation with Tony Khan. Ospreay challenged his rival to finally step back into an AEW arena and prove who the real champion is. Although MJF has recently shifted his focus to calling out talent in New Japan Pro Wrestling, a future showdown between him and Ospreay is still widely anticipated.

stories.title: Tony Khan says Paramount and WBD merger will strengthen AEW
stories.tldr: Following the official finalization of the merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. under Skydance, Tony Khan remains enthusiastic about AEW's future on TBS, TNT, and Max. Building on his established relationship with CEO David Ellison, Khan stated during a recent media call that the combined media powerhouse will ultimately make AEW an even stronger company. He praised Ellison's vision for keeping the networks and streaming under one roof while navigating the transition with both familiar and new leadership.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo reacts to unusual AEW crowd chants
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo recently defended his title at AEW WrestleDream in a match featuring a comedic spot where Tommaso Ciampa pinned his discarded pants. Tony Khan later addressed the humorous moment during his post-show press conference. Elaborating on the origin of the bit, Andrade revealed that the fan chants for him to remove his pants started entirely by accident. He explained that he was initially confused by the crowd's request until referee Aubrey Edwards clarified what the audience was shouting.

stories.title: MJF Comments on Will Ospreay and Ilja Dragunov
stories.tldr: Following AEW WrestleDream, former world champion MJF took to social media to share a scathing review of the event despite his absence from the show. He targeted AEW World Champion Will Ospreay, dismissing his title reign, and mocked the shocking debut of former WWE star Ilja Dragunov. MJF also highlighted Nick Wayne's recent victories over Chris Jericho and engaged in a separate war of words with New Japan Pro-Wrestling star Ryohei Oiwa.

stories.title: Billy Gunn on Early AEW Career Plans and Backstage Drama
stories.tldr: Billy Gunn recently revealed that his initial AEW contract only called for 12 wrestling dates per year because he was primarily hired for backstage coaching and producing roles. However, those plans quickly changed when Tony Khan began using him regularly across both weekly shows, leaving him feeling overworked. Additionally, Gunn addressed modern locker room drama by comparing today's wrestling culture unfavorably to his WWE days under Vince McMahon. He argued that modern wrestlers should handle personal conflicts privately behind closed doors like adults rather than letting issues boil over in public view.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Childhood Wrestling Influences and Cardio
stories.tldr: AEW star Will Ospreay recently discussed the origins of his high-flying in-ring style and his impressive physical conditioning in a new interview. He credited his mother for supporting his early ambitions by first buying a trampoline and later installing a backyard wrestling ring to keep him out of trouble. Ospreay studied WCW cruiserweights on television, pausing and rewinding tapes to master their body movements before practicing the moves at home. He also joked about his elite stamina for demanding matches, proudly declaring that he is a cardio machine.

stories.title: Max Caster Steps Away from Ring
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Max Caster has announced an indefinite hiatus from professional wrestling following his controversial firing from TNA. During his debut at TNA Bound for Glory, Caster delivered an unapproved freestyle rap referencing recent missile attacks in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, prompting his immediate release by the promotion. After issuing a public apology admitting he went too far, Caster appeared at an independent wrestling event to thank fans and reveal his plans to step away from the ring to focus on therapy and personal reflection.

stories.title: Harley Cameron and Kris Statlander Match at AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Harley Cameron and Kris Statlander, known as Wrathlander, previously missed an AEW Women's World Championship opportunity at WrestleDream due to an injury to Jamie Hayter. Despite this setback, the duo has shifted their focus to hunting down the Brawling Birds for tag team gold instead. AEW recently released a humorous vignette featuring the team on a bird-watching expedition to hype up their pursuit of the champions. Wrathlander will officially receive their title shot as soon as Hayter is medically cleared to compete.

stories.title: Charlette Renegade AEW and ROH Status Update
stories.tldr: Fans have wondered about Charlette Renegade's absence from Ring of Honor and All Elite Wrestling television while her twin sister Robyn continues to appear. Reports clarify that tentative plans for Charlette's return ultimately fell through following earlier discussions about involving the duo with champion Mercedes Mone. Outside of the ring, Charlette has married fellow wrestler Hunter Knott and begun apprenticing at her family barbershop to help maintain the multi-generation business.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa Discusses Move to AEW
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa reflects positively on his career move to All Elite Wrestling since joining the promotion earlier this year. The former WWE star notes that the transition has greatly improved his family life by allowing his wife and daughter to travel the globe with him. Ciampa specifically highlights memorable experiences, such as his daughter Willow participating in international trips and a special on-screen birthday celebration during a recent major pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Toni Storm Discovery and Return Updates
stories.tldr: Following Tony Khan's recent comments about Toni Storm's eventual return, tangible clues have begun surfacing regarding her mysterious absence. Content creator Astrid Pizarro was directly handed a cassette tape labeled one of five at AEW WrestleDream. The audio, narrated by Renee Paquette, reveals that a package containing analog cassettes arrived at the AEW Jacksonville office featuring Toni's day-to-day life and advice.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream Reviews and Discussion
stories.tldr: Following his successful title defense at WrestleDream, Will Ospreay has broken his silence on the chaotic Clockwork Carnage main event. The champion revealed that he personally came up with the concept for the innovative bout, expressing pride in trying something entirely new. Meanwhile, the rest of the pay-per-view card featured a massive lineup of title defenses, intense feuds, and a major surprise debut by former WWE star Ilja Dragunov.

stories.title: Kairi Sane AEW Signing Rumors and Delay
stories.tldr: Speculation surrounding Kairi Sane joining AEW continues as new details emerge regarding the reasons behind her delayed debut. Reports indicate that her pending work visa is the primary hurdle holding up a finalized agreement. Meanwhile, Tony Khan has publicly expressed intrigue about her free agency, and ongoing talks with AEW have temporarily paused her potential opportunities in Japan.

stories.title: Hangman Page, Brodido, and Bandido win AEW World Trios Championship at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: At AEW WrestleDream in Orlando, Florida, Hangman Adam Page and Brodido reclaimed the AEW World Trios Championship by defeating Swerve Strickland and The New Level in a grueling two-out-of-three falls match. After dropping the titles initially at AEW All In and failing to win them back at All Out, the challengers finally evened the score and secured the victory when Bandido rolled up Strickland in the deciding third fall. Post-match celebrations were marred by tension as Strickland refused to show respect to Page, dropping his title belt onto the canvas and walking out alone while his teammates respectfully handed their titles over to the new champions.

stories.title: Will Ospreay retains AEW World Championship in Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay successfully defended his AEW World Championship at WrestleDream by surviving the inaugural eight-man Clockwork Carnage match. The chaotic bout combined a gauntlet eliminator phase with a 15-minute Iron Man-style scoring period. After enduring submissions, pins, and a furious late-game rally by Adam Copeland, Ospreay secured his third point with a last-second Hidden Blade to retain the gold.

stories.title: Jay White returns to ring action during AEW WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl
stories.tldr: Jay White made a surprise and early return to AEW in-ring action during the WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl after suffering an injury at All Out. Originally projected to miss one to two months, White beat his prognosis and teamed with The Gunns and The Conglomeration in a 12-man tag team match. Despite a strong individual showing, his team ultimately lost to The Death Riders and The Dogs following late-match interference. Meanwhile, the event also featured Maya World announcing her medical clearance and victories by Divine Dominion and the Don Callis Family on the pre-show.

stories.title: Nick Wayne defeats Chris Jericho at AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: Nick Wayne defeated Chris Jericho in the decisive rubber match of their trilogy at AEW WrestleDream 2026, winning their three-match series 2-1. The chaotic encounter featured water spitting, multiple near falls, and a comedic sequence involving a protective cup and retaliatory low blows. Ultimately, Wayne capitalized on a missed Judas Effect to secure a flash roll-up victory over the veteran, cementing his status with a second consecutive win over the former world champion.

stories.title: Tony Khan provides update on 'Timeless' Toni Storm's return to AEW
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan provided a positive update regarding the status of "Timeless" Toni Storm during the WrestleDream post-event media scrum. Storm has been absent since a March 2026 episode of Dynamite following a mystery backstage attack storyline that wrote her off television. Although Khan did not provide a specific return date, he confirmed she will eventually make her comeback to seek revenge on her attacker. Meanwhile, the women's division has continued to move forward, anchored by World Champion Mercedes Mone.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné gives update following broken nose surgery
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone has revealed that despite undergoing surgery a month and a half ago, her nose is still very much broken. She suffered the original injury during her title victory against Willow Nightingale at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Refusing to let the setback slow her down, she has continued to defend her championship, including a recent successful defense against Thekla at AEW WrestleDream.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov's AEW in-ring debut scheduled for October 21 Dynamite
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov made a surprise appearance at AEW WrestleDream on October 17, 2026, officially confirming he is All Elite after weeks of teased vignettes. During the post-show media scrum alongside Tony Khan and Renee Paquette, it was announced that Dragunov will waste no time getting into the ring. His official AEW in-ring debut is scheduled for the October 21 episode of Dynamite at the Watsco Center in Coral Gables, Florida. While his opponent has not yet been revealed, his arrival follows the resolution of visa issues after his WWE contract expired in August.

stories.title: Jon Moxley retains AEW Continental Championship against Mark Davis at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley successfully defended his AEW Continental Championship against Mark Davis in a brutal, bloody, and emotional match at AEW WrestleDream 2026. The bout carried heavy emotional weight for Moxley and the Death Riders as they continued to cope with the recent loss of PAC. Despite suffering a nasty head wound, enduring multiple dangerous apron piledrivers, and absorbing immense punishment, Moxley ultimately forced Davis to pass out in a rear-naked choke. Following the exhausting victory, an emotionally drained Moxley shared a powerful moment with his stablemates in the ring.

stories.title: Persephone retains AEW TBS Championship in Four-Way match at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Persephone successfully defended her AEW TBS Championship against Dani Luna, Queen Aminata, and HYAN in a hard-fought four-way match at AEW WrestleDream 2026. Despite a chaotic bout featuring high-impact moves from all challengers, the dominant champion ultimately secured the victory by executing a moonsault on HYAN. Since winning the title at All In in August 2026, Persephone continues to solidify her reign as a fighting champion. As she celebrated, a color commentator aptly noted her return to the darkness with her titles.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné retains AEW Women's World Title against Thekla at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone successfully defended her AEW Women's World Championship against Thekla at AEW WrestleDream 2026 in a hard-fought 15-minute encounter. After a grueling back and forth battle that saw both competitors utilize high-impact maneuvers and outside interference with a faceguard, Mone ultimately countered Thekla to land her signature Moné Maker. The victory marks Mone's second successful title defense since winning the belt back at AEW All In 2026, bringing her current reign to 49 days while leaving her next challenger yet to be announced.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo defeats Tommaso Ciampa to retain AEW National Championship at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: At AEW WrestleDream 2026, Andrade El Idolo successfully defended his AEW National Championship against Tommaso Ciampa in a match that blended hard-hitting action with heavy doses of comedy. Both competitors engaged in mid-match antics involving selfies with fans and family, as well as a memorable running gag where they stripped off their outer pants to reveal custom trunks. After a chaotic sequence featuring near falls, weapon disallowances by the referee, and even a comedic pinfall attempt on Andrade's discarded pants, Andrade ultimately secured the victory by hitting Widow's Bell onto the title belt followed by The DM.

stories.title: AEW's Maya World cleared to return to in-ring action
stories.tldr: Former AEW TBS Champion Maya World has officially announced that she is medically cleared to return to in-ring competition. Sidelined since September 2026 following a medical procedure related to appendicitis, World made a surprise appearance on the AEW WrestleDream Buy-In pre-show. She shared the good news with hosts Renee Paquette, Jeff Jarrett, and R.J. City before celebrating her clearance on social media. While an official return date has not been announced, her clearance paves the way for her reentry into the women's division.

stories.title: Samoa Joe discusses future in AEW and retirement plans
stories.tldr: AEW star Samoa Joe recently addressed his future in professional wrestling and his eventual retirement plans during an interview with SHAK Wrestling. The veteran of over two decades stated that he does not yet have a specific timeline or definitive endpoint for when he will step away from the ring. Instead, Joe's primary focus is on delivering meaningful, entertaining matches and creating as many lasting memories for fans as possible while he still has the opportunity.

stories.title: Tony Khan reveals 9/30 Dynamite was originally planned as seven-year anniversary show
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan revealed during the WrestleDream media scrum that the September 30 episode of Dynamite was originally intended to be the promotion's seven-year anniversary celebration. However, plans changed following the tragic passing of Benjamin Satterley, known to fans as PAC, the day after the 2026 All Out pay-per-view. Instead of celebrating the milestone, the company shifted focus entirely to honor Satterley with a heartfelt tribute show. Khan explained that celebrating PAC's life and accomplishments was far more important than marking the anniversary or building toward upcoming events.

stories.title: Tony Khan instructed commentary to clarify Andrade pinning Tommaso Ciampa's pants at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: At AEW WrestleDream, Andrade El Idolo successfully defended his title against Tommaso Ciampa in a match featuring a comedic moment where Ciampa pinned Andrade's discarded pants. Tony Khan addressed the spot during the post-show press conference, explaining that he personally instructed commentary to clarify that Ciampa was engaging in mind games rather than attempting a legitimate pinfall. Khan compared the lighthearted tactic to the psychological games played by stars like Orange Cassidy while emphasizing that the broadcast team ensured the match retained its sporting context.

stories.title: Tony Khan explains AEW's approach to running house shows
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan recently explained why the company avoids running a heavy schedule of traditional house shows. Speaking at the post-WrestleDream media scrum, Khan emphasized that a lighter live event schedule helps protect wrestlers from the physical toll of AEW's hard-hitting TV style. Instead of filling the calendar with untelevised events, AEW selectively runs occasional house shows to provide reps for younger talent, test new markets, and record content. Ultimately, Khan wants to ensure every event bearing the AEW name delivers a high-quality experience without burning out the roster.

stories.title: Tony Khan expresses interest in collaborating with Pro Wrestling EVE around AEW PPVs
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling President Tony Khan recently expressed enthusiasm about the prospect of collaborating with Pro Wrestling EVE to host joint events surrounding major pay-per-view weekends in the United States. The two promotions have already maintained a working relationship for over a year, which includes events airing on MyAEW, talent sharing like Kris Statlander holding the EVE Championship, and Will Ospreay contributing to EVE's creative team. Speaking at the recent WrestleDream press conference alongside Ospreay, Khan noted that similar weekend partnerships have previously worked well with Ring of Honor. Ospreay strongly echoed this sentiment, stating that he would love to make a larger collaboration happen if the opportunity arises.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream 2026 review
stories.tldr: This review of AEW WrestleDream 2026 highlights staff opinions on three things they hated and three things they loved from the Orlando event. While the show featured moments like Ilja Dragunov's debut and a wild tag title match, the column focuses on other bouts, including a poorly received enhancement match and a standout women's championship match. The review heavily criticizes a pointless squash match while praising Mercedes Mone and Thekla for delivering a strong title bout with great psychology.

stories.title: Analysis on who will eventually defeat Mercedes Moné for the AEW Women's World Title
stories.tldr: Following Mercedes Mone retaining her AEW Women's World Championship against Thekla at AEW WrestleDream 2026, speculation is growing regarding who will eventually end her dominant reign. Potential challengers include high-profile names like Kairi and Bayley, whose recent WWE departures or expiring contracts have fueled industry rumors. Alternatively, current roster members such as a newly cleared Maya World, Alex Windsor, Dani Luna, Hyan, Megan Bayne, or a returning Toni Storm could step up to dethrone the CEO.

stories.title: Identity of fan taking selfie with Andrade during WrestleDream match revealed
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo continued his growing trend of interacting with women at ringside during AEW WrestleDream by stopping for a selfie and kissing independent wrestler Madisyn Maxxwell on the cheek. This follows similar viral moments involving indie wrestler Kelly Madan on television and Instagram personality bad.oce at Grand Slam France. The recurring mid-match antics are quickly becoming a signature part of Andrade's current character routine.

stories.title: Profane chants erupt during Brody King's match at AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: During the AEW WrestleDream pay-per-view on October 17, 2026, loud profane chants directed at ICE erupted from the crowd as Brody King entered the ring during a World Trios Championship match. The commentary team fell completely silent to let the unacknowledged crowd noise broadcast clearly across the arena. This marked the latest in a recurring series of anti-ICE chants following King due to his vocal activism and merchandise efforts supporting immigrant families.

stories.title: Don Callis Family tension teased following AEW WrestleDream losses
stories.tldr: The Don Callis Family is facing potential internal collapse following a disastrous night at AEW WrestleDream. Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight failed to capture the AEW World Tag Team Championship from The Young Bucks after miscommunication plagued their match. A heated argument and an accidental mid-air lariat by Knight on Fletcher ultimately cost them the bout and deeply fractured their partnership.

stories.title: The Young Bucks retain AEW World Tag Team Titles at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: At AEW WrestleDream 2026, the Young Bucks successfully defended their AEW World Tag Team Championship against Kevin Knight and Kyle Fletcher. The challengers had earned their title opportunity at All Out by defeating Steven Borden and Darby Allin via stoppage. Despite controlling much of the bout with aggressive tactics and near-falls, internal friction between Knight and Fletcher derailed their momentum. The champions ultimately capitalized on the miscommunication to land a decisive BTE Trigger for the victory.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns defeat FTR at AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: The Motor City Machine Guns defeated FTR in the opening match of their best of five series at AEW WrestleDream 2026, taking a 1-0 lead. The unique bout began during the Tailgate Brawl pre-show and transitioned into the main card opener. After surviving a dangerous spike piledriver attempt, Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin isolated Cash Wheeler from Dax Harwood to secure the pinfall victory. MCMG now need just two more consecutive wins to sweep the series, marking the first-ever one-on-one tag team clash between the decorated duos.

stories.title: Divine Dominion defeats Sisters of Sin at AEW WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl
stories.tldr: Divine Dominion secured a major victory over the Sisters of Sin at the AEW WrestleDream Tailgate Brawl to settle a bitter rivalry. The grudge match was fueled by revenge after Julia Hart and Skye Blue previously used the Black Mist against Lena Kross and Megan Bayne. Despite a strong showing of speed and teamwork from their opponents, Divine Dominion relied on their signature power to ultimately deliver a double chokeslam on Hart for the pinfall. The win gives Kross and Bayne much-needed momentum to rebuild following previous title losses in the women's tag team division.

stories.title: Kevin Nash praises Will Ospreay vs. Kenny Omega match from All In
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Kevin Nash revealed on his Kliq This podcast that he was deeply moved by the AEW All In match between Will Ospreay and Kenny Omega. Despite it being far from his preferred wrestling style, Nash praised the bout and even fantasy booked a dream tag team match. He expressed a desire to see Ospreay and Omega face off against WWE stars Seth Rollins and Roman Reigns to witness a major clash of styles.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens reflects on his coming out segment in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW star Anthony Bowens recently reflected on his memorable June 2023 coming out segment on Rampage where he rejected Harley Cameron's advances by stating he is gay. Pitched by QT Marshall to celebrate Pride Month, Bowens appreciated that the in-ring moment was lighthearted rather than overly serious. Although disappointed that the taped segment was edited down and missed some of the deafening live crowd reactions, Bowens remembers it as an incredible and heartwarming experience shared with his Acclaimed stablemates and Billy Gunn.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale opens up about dealing with imposter syndrome
stories.tldr: AEW star Willow Nightingale recently discussed her struggles with imposter syndrome as she has risen to the top of the women's division. Appearing on The Mick and Kenny Show, she explained how she combats self-doubt before major events by reminding herself that she earned her position. Nightingale noted that managing psychological pressure is often harder than dealing with physical injuries like a broken hand. Despite these internal and external challenges, she continues to remain active and compete in high-profile matches for the company.

stories.title: Will Ospreay expresses desire to wrestle Adam Copeland before Copeland retires
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay has expressed a strong desire to face Adam Copeland in a singles match before the WWE Hall of Famer officially retires in 2027. Following Copeland's recent retirement announcement and qualification for the Clockwork Carnage match at AEW WrestleDream 2026, Ospreay reflected on growing up as a fan and the crucial support Copeland provided during his own neck surgery recovery. The reigning AEW World Champion delivered a direct message telling Copeland to save a date for a future one-on-one showdown. Both wrestlers are set to collide tonight in the championship main event in Orlando, Florida.

stories.title: Mercedes Martinez provides surgery update following injury
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Mercedes Martinez has provided a positive health update after undergoing successful surgery on October 15 to repair a torn ACL and MCL following her retirement in August. The procedure also addressed unexpected arthritis discovered during the operation, and Martinez has already begun at-home rehabilitation. She expressed profound gratitude to the wrestling community after confirming that a GoFundMe campaign successfully covered her medical expenses in full.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov makes surprise debut at AEW WrestleDream 2026 and signs with AEW
stories.tldr: Following weeks of cryptic teasers, Ilja Dragunov made his official surprise debut at AEW WrestleDream 2026 in Orlando, signing a full-time contract with the company. Tony Khan later revealed that Dragunov's visa clearance came down to the wire during a live broadcast just days before the event. Dragunov expressed his hunger for fresh competition during the post-show media scrum, naming stars like Jon Moxley and Samoa Joe as potential opponents.

stories.title: Tony Khan discusses talks with David Ellison regarding AEW's future under Skydance
stories.tldr: Expanding on his recent discussions with Skydance CEO David Ellison, Tony Khan shared fresh details regarding their shared background and strategic alignment. Khan noted that Ellison is a wrestling fan around his own age who already shares an NFL business connection with them. Furthermore, Ellison intends to keep TBS, TNT, and Warner Bros streaming united under one roof, seamlessly protecting AEW's current broadcasting ecosystem following their 2024 rights renewal.

stories.title: Tony Khan addresses interest in Kairi Sane appearing in AEW
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has addressed the ongoing speculation surrounding Kairi Sane during the post-WrestleDream media scrum. While a deal remains unfinalized, Khan openly admitted he is very intrigued by her free-agency status and praised her in-ring abilities. Sources report that light discussions are continuing, though outside interest from Japan is currently being weighed alongside the potential AEW talks.

stories.title: AEW backstage updates on Dragunov, Kairi Sane, MJF, Kenny Omega, and Samoa Joe
stories.tldr: Following the confirmation of Ilja Dragunov signing with AEW, backstage updates reveal further roster developments including Kairi Sane in ongoing talks with the company and MJF nearing a return to the world title picture. Additionally, Kenny Omega recently made a last-minute decision to wrestle on Dynamite, Samoa Joe's upcoming availability depends on his Twisted Metal obligations, and Billy Gunn remains active behind the scenes. Other notes include planned talent appearances in Japan, early discussions for a 2027 Atlanta show, and travel schedule complaints ahead of upcoming events in Minneapolis and Liverpool.

stories.title: Ticket sales update for AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: AEW WrestleDream 2026 has reached 6,695 distributed tickets ahead of tonight's pay-per-view in Orlando, Florida. This final day-of-show push brings the count up 71 tickets from Friday, with 451 seats currently remaining on the map. The event is trending to finish slightly below last year's total and stands as one of the lowest-attended AEW pay-per-views of the year.

stories.title: Updated betting odds released for AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: Following initial projections, fresh betting figures for AEW WrestleDream have revealed odds for the Clockwork Carnage match and several newly added bouts. Champions like Will Ospreay, The Young Bucks, and Jon Moxley have seen their already heavy favoritism grow significantly larger. Meanwhile, competitive opening lines have been established for matches involving Chris Jericho, FTR, and the TBS Championship scene.

stories.title: Official cause of death revealed for Benjamin 'PAC' Satterley
stories.tldr: The official cause of death for professional wrestler Benjamin Satterley, known as PAC in AEW and Neville in WWE, has been determined as bronchial asthma. Satterley was found unresponsive in a rental car near Chicago O'Hare International Airport on September 27 at the age of 40. Investigators confirmed his passing was due to natural causes following weeks of pending autopsy and test results. The sudden loss prompted widespread emotional tributes from both AEW and WWE colleagues, as well as his widow, Natalie.

stories.title: AEW updates Full Gear 2026 logo with tributes to PAC
stories.tldr: AEW has updated the official logo and poster for the upcoming Full Gear 2026 pay-per-view to honor the late PAC, who passed away unexpectedly at the age of 40 on September 27. The redesigned artwork features several emotional tributes, including a Black Arrow Warning sign, black arrows in the event cogs, and PAC's signature Death Riders chair and towel. These elements celebrate both his in-ring legacy and his historical connection to the event, as his memorable appearance in full wrestling gear at AEW's 2019 launch rally originally inspired the pay-per-view's name.

stories.title: Austin Creed teases new gaming channel project after leaving UpUpDownDown
stories.tldr: After leaving WWE earlier this year and parting ways with the popular UpUpDownDown YouTube gaming channel, Austin Creed recently hinted at launching a brand new gaming project during an appearance at PAX Australia. WWE retains ownership of the UpUpDownDown brand, meaning Creed cannot take the channel with him to his new home in AEW. However, Creed teased the potential reunion of his former gaming group Da Party, noting that none of its members are currently under WWE contract. While refusing to explicitly confirm if a new channel is already being filmed, he emphasized that building a strong rapport with the AEW locker room remains his top priority before launching any future gaming content.

stories.title: Independent wrestlers make entrance appearances on AEW and TNA television
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling talents Sofia Sivan and Tatevik recently made television appearances by participating in entrance presentations for established stars on major programming. Sivan appeared as an extra during Mustafa Ali’s entrance at TNA Bound For Glory, while Tatevik has become a recurring presence accompanying Andrade El Idolo on AEW Dynamite. These appearances provide valuable national exposure for independent wrestlers, though there is no indication that either talent has signed a permanent contract with AEW or TNA.

stories.title: Kevin Knight comments on Tony Khan calling him a future pillar of AEW
stories.tldr: Rising star Kevin Knight recently expressed his deep appreciation after AEW President Tony Khan named him as one of the company's future pillars during an interview on TMZ Inside The Ring. Knight admitted that being grouped alongside established names like Mercedes Mone, Thekla, and Kyle Fletcher was a massive surprise given his relatively short time in the promotion. The endorsement has served as a major confidence boost for Knight, validating his hard work since transitioning from his initial dual contract with New Japan. He will look to capitalize on this momentum when he teams with Kyle Fletcher to challenge The Young Bucks for the AEW World Tag Team Championships at WrestleDream on October 17.

stories.title: Brian Cage frustrated after being left off AEW WrestleDream card
stories.tldr: Brian Cage expressed major frustration on social media after being left off the AEW WrestleDream pay-per-view card. Despite recent praise for his strong in-ring performances and improved promo work, the athletic anomaly pointed out that he has missed every single pay-per-view event this year. Cage believes he already has the necessary momentum and only needs a small nudge from management to deliver in the spotlight. He concluded his car rant by demanding an actual opportunity to be featured on major events rather than just receiving compliments.

stories.title: Adam Copeland talks joining AEW opening doors to historic venues
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently discussed how his 2023 move to AEW allowed him to fulfill lifelong childhood dreams by performing in legendary wrestling venues that he never thought he would see. During an interview on Daily Faceoff, the WWE Hall of Famer explained that wrestling in places like Wembley Stadium, Arena Mexico, and Maple Leaf Gardens has kept him energized late in his career. Copeland noted that he doubted these opportunities would ever happen during his 2020 WWE return, making his recent milestone achievements truly mind-blowing.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite television viewership for October 14, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite experienced a significant viewership increase for its October 14, 2026 episode on TBS. The show drew 715,000 viewers and a 0.14 rating in the key P18 to 49 demographic, marking a substantial jump from the previous week. These numbers also represent a strong year-over-year improvement compared to the exact same week in 2025.

stories.title: AEW Collision television viewership for October 14, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Collision experienced a significant viewership surge on October 14, 2026, pulling in 514,000 viewers and a 0.1 rating in the key P18 to 49 demographic on TBS. This marked a substantial improvement from the October 10 episode, which only reached 372,000 viewers and a 0.04 demo rating. While total viewership also saw a strong year-over-year increase compared to October 2025, the key demographic rating experienced a slight dip. These figures strictly measure linear television audiences on TBS without accounting for digital or streaming platforms.

stories.title: Sheamus (S. Farrelly) books convention appearance on day of AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Sheamus, now performing as S. Farrelly, has become a free agent and recently booked a fan convention appearance on the exact same day as AEW Full Gear. He has reportedly asked to leave the convention early to attend a wedding, fueling ongoing speculation about a potential future with AEW where many talent and executives are interested in signing him. Meanwhile, TNA had previously pursued him for a major appearance as well, though that booking never materialized.

stories.title: Wrestling Weekly on Carmelo Hayes in The 946 and AEW WrestleDream predictions
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestling analysts Les Thatcher and Vic Sosa return for a new episode of Wrestling Weekly to discuss the major recent appearance of Carmelo Hayes. During the show, the hosts break down Hayes aligning himself as the latest member of The 946. Additionally, Thatcher and Sosa provide their expert predictions and analysis for the upcoming AEW WrestleDream pay-per-view event taking place this weekend.

stories.title: Update on Kairi Sane contract status heading into AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Speculation continues regarding Kairi Sane and her potential involvement with All Elite Wrestling as the WrestleDream 2026 pay-per-view approaches. Despite ongoing rumors, sources report that both sides have still not finalized a confirmed agreement as of this week. It remains completely unclear if a deal will be struck in time or when she might officially debut for the promotion.

stories.title: Betting odds released for AEW WrestleDream 2026
stories.tldr: The betting odds for AEW WrestleDream 2026 have been released by betonline.ag, providing an early projection for the upcoming pay-per-view card. Champions like Jon Moxley, Mercedes Mone, and The Young Bucks enter their respective matches as overwhelming favorites. Meanwhile, competitive bouts like the AEW National Championship and the multi-man AEW World Title Clockwork Carnage Match offer varying margins for the challengers. Fans can look forward to a night of high-stakes championship action as these storylines culminate.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream 2026 ticket sales update
stories.tldr: AEW WrestleDream 2026 is set to take place on Saturday, October 17, at the Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, Florida, with ticket sales surging to 6,005 distributed tickets according to recent tracking data. This puts the current numbers just shy of last year's total of 6,293 tickets distributed at the Chaifetz Arena in St. Louis. Fans looking to attend still have options, with about 141 tickets currently available on the resale market and standard admission prices starting at $36.40. The event features a loaded match card headlined by a massive Clockwork Carnage match for the AEW World Championship and several other high-profile title bouts.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa discusses interest in wrestling for NJPW
stories.tldr: AEW star Tommaso Ciampa recently expressed interest in wrestling for New Japan Pro-Wrestling during an interview ahead of AEW WrestleDream 2026. He specifically named Shingo Takagi as a dream opponent he would love to share the ring with. While he is open to sporadic appearances or a short stint of a few shows, he expressed doubts about whether his body could handle the grueling schedule of a full tour or the iconic G1 Climax tournament. Ciampa previously wrestled under the joint ROH and NJPW banner in 2014, and he is currently preparing to challenge Andrade for the National title at WrestleDream 2026.

stories.title: AEW releases vignettes teasing Ilja Dragunov debut at WrestleDream
stories.tldr: AEW has followed up its initial television teaser with a second promotional video for the impending debut of former WWE star Ilja Dragunov. The latest social media post explicitly includes the WrestleDream hashtag and a tomorrow caption, pointing directly to the upcoming pay-per-view event in Orlando. Dragunov parted ways with WWE earlier this year when his contract expired following an extended absence from television.

stories.title: Steven Borden recovery progress update following AEW All Out injury
stories.tldr: Steven Borden is making positive recovery progress following his scary head injury at AEW All Out. He was recently spotted backstage at the October 14 television tapings in Cleveland, Ohio. Tony Khan provided a reassuring update on a media call, stating that Borden is doing fantastic. There is still no confirmed timetable for his in-ring return.

stories.title: AEW alters WrestleDream Clockwork Carnage main event plans due to injuries
stories.tldr: A wave of injuries coming out of All Out has forced AEW to heavily alter its plans for the upcoming WrestleDream pay-per-view. In addition to Adam Copeland replacing the injured Jay White in the World Championship Clockwork Carnage match, Christian Cage suffered a collapsed lung and broken ribs, putting his tag team with Copeland on hold. Furthermore, Women's Tag Team Champion Jamie Hayter is sidelined with a minor injury, forcing a postponement of her title defense and a shakeup of the women's card.

stories.title: AEW wrestler added to CMLL Women's Grand Prix as Shotzi replacement
stories.tldr: Marina Shafir is heading to Mexico to replace Shotzi Blackheart in the upcoming CMLL Women's Grand Prix. Blackheart withdrew from the tournament following the tragic passing of her brother. The 11-on-11 cibernetico match takes place on October 23 at Arena Mexico and features a mix of AEW, Stardom, and CMLL talent. Fans can stream the event live through MyAEW or CMLL's YouTube membership.

stories.title: Updates on Ilja Dragunov and Kairi Sane status ahead of AEW WrestleDream
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov has officially signed with AEW after resolving his visa situation, with his recent cryptic vignette confirmed to be building toward his debut. It remains unconfirmed whether he will make his first appearance at the upcoming WrestleDream pay-per-view. Meanwhile, AEW has also held discussions with former WWE star Kairi Sane, though no official agreement has been reached yet.

stories.title: Austin Creed on leaving WWE, joining AEW, and feeling revitalized
stories.tldr: After debuting in AEW alongside Swerve Strickland, Austin Creed and Kofi are opening up about their transition. Creed recently revealed he contemplated jumping to AEW while still in WWE to experience a different style of wrestling. He and Kofi now feel completely revitalized by the passionate crowds and creative grind in their new home. Furthermore, the duo is already beginning to branch out into singles competition.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett reacts to Max Caster's rap controversy at TNA Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: Max Caster was recently fired by TNA following a controversial unapproved rap at Bound for Glory that referenced Riyadh and a glory hole. While figures like Jim Cornette initially weighed in to defend him, AEW veteran Jeff Jarrett has now shared his thoughts on the situation. Jarrett criticized the lack of forethought and accountability while questioning who greenlit the promo. TNA President Carlos Silva ultimately made the swift decision to terminate Caster, leaving the wrestler as a free agent.
